title: Reprogramming efficiency of mouse embryonic fibroblasts using pMX-based retroviral expression vectors: testing factors that enhance efficiency.
protocol: Plate 2.2 x 10^6 293T cells per 10 cm dish in MEF medium.
Ensure even distribution of cells over the plate.
Transfect 293T cells with 2 μg pMX vector containing factor of interest.
Include an empty pMX vector transfection to adjust for additions during infection.
Add 2 μg pClEco packaging plasmid to the mixture.
Mix by flicking and let stand at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Add the mixture to the cells.
Replace the medium of transfected 293T cells with 10 ml MEF medium/10 cm dish.
Passage P2 or P3 of OG2MEFs in MEF medium in a 1 x 15 cm dish.
Ensure the plate is gelatinized before plating.
Wait until the next morning when the plate should be 70-80% confluent.
Split OG2MEFs at 50,000 cells per well of a gelatinized 6-well plate.
Ensure MEFs are evenly distributed over each well.
Harvest the supernatant of transfected 293T plates using a syringe.
Filter sterilize the harvested supernatant through a 0.45 μm low protein binding filter.
Add fresh MEF medium (10 ml/10 cm dish) to the transfected 293T cells for a second harvest after 24 hours.
Prepare the infection mix in 15 ml tubes.
Use 250 μl viral supernatant per factor.
Add empty pMX viral supernatant when infecting with fewer factors to maintain consistent amounts of viral supernatant across experiments.
Add protamine sulphate to achieve a final concentration of 5 μg/ml.
Infect in triplicate using a combination of viral supernatants.
Combine 250 μl viral supernatant each of the OSKM reprogramming factors oct4, sox2, klf4, c-myc.
Add 250 μl of each TFIID-12 factors (TBP, TAF3, TAF4, TAF4b, TAF5, TAF6, TAF7, TAF9, TAF10, TAF11, TAF12, TAF13).
Mix gently to achieve a total volume of 4 ml.
Add protamine sulfate from a 5 mg/ml stock solution at a ratio of 1:1000.
Replace the medium of OG2 MEFs with the infection mix, using up to 4 ml per well in a 6-well plate.
Repeat the infection once more on day 5 using new viral supernatant formed in the last 24 hours.
Discard the 293T cells after repeating the infection.
Change the medium of infected OG2 MEFs to ES medium on day 6, refreshing daily thereafter.
Trypsinize infected MEFs and plate all cells from a 3.5 cm dish into a 10 cm gelatinized dish when confluency reaches ~90-95%.
